edges.mechanism: Bacopa suppressed plasma AChE in a 12-week human RCT and shows anticholinesterase activity in animals; additive cholinergic effects (GI upset, bradycardia) are possible with donepezil/rivastigmine/galantamine.
edges.evidence: Human RCT (AChE marker) plus preclinical/review data; trials vs donepezil reported no major safety issues; low certainty

edges.mechanism: Suspected cholinergic toxicity (hyperhidrosis, nausea, tachycardia) after a Bacopa/phosphatidylserine supplement was added to cevimeline; pharmacodynamic cholinergic overlap and possible CYP-mediated reduced clearance.
edges.evidence: Single case report; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Pharmacodynamic opposition: Bacopa reverses scopolamine-induced amnesia and lowers AChE in rodents; could blunt or be blunted by anticholinergic therapy.
edges.evidence: Animal data only; no clinical reports

edges.mechanism: GABAergic modulation and traditional anxiolytic/calming use suggest possible additive sedation with benzodiazepines, hypnotics or alcohol.
edges.evidence: Preclinical GABA-receptor data and clinical reviews; no human interaction study

edges.mechanism: Extract competitively inhibits CYP3A4 in vitro (Ki 14.5 ug/mL; predicted >90% gut inhibition at 300 mg/d); in rats 7-day pretreatment raised carbamazepine AUC 4-fold and down-regulated hepatic/intestinal CYP3A.
edges.evidence: In vitro and rat PK; another in vitro study found weak inhibition; no human probe study

edges.mechanism: Non-competitive in vitro inhibition of CYP2C19 (Ki 9.5 ug/mL), CYP2C9 (Ki 12.5) and CYP1A2 (Ki 25.1) by whole extract; bacosides alone negligible.
edges.evidence: In vitro only; conflicting in vitro data; no human study

edges.mechanism: Bacopa extract and bacopaside II inhibit P-gp in vitro; rat pretreatment reduced intestinal P-gp and raised digoxin AUC 1.3-fold.
edges.evidence: In vitro and rat PK; no human data

edges.mechanism: Pharmacovigilance: one serotonin syndrome after Bacopa was added to antidepressant therapy; chart-review adverse events with agomelatine and moclobemide; serotonergic activity and CYP/P-gp inhibition proposed.
edges.evidence: Case series / pharmacovigilance; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Bacopa extract raised serum T4 by 41% in mice; additive effect with levothyroxine is theoretical.
edges.evidence: Animal data only; no human data

edges.mechanism: Endothelial NO-mediated vasodilation and calcium-channel antagonism; hypotensive in anaesthetized rats; acute human doses did not change cardiovascular measures.
edges.evidence: Animal/in vitro plus null acute human data

edges.mechanism: Thyroid-stimulating (T4-raising) effect in mice; reviews advise caution in hyperthyroidism.
edges.evidence: Animal data and expert review

edges.mechanism: No human safety data; reviews advise caution. Ayurvedic products may also be contaminated with lead.
edges.evidence: Absence of data; review-level precaution

edges.mechanism: Brahmi 250 mg/kg/d reversibly suppressed spermatogenesis and fertility in mice; a standardized CDRI-08 extract improved sperm quality in mice. No human data.
edges.evidence: Conflicting animal data

edges.mechanism: Dose-related nausea, abdominal cramps, increased stool frequency and diarrhea are the most consistent adverse effects; cholinergic and smooth-muscle actions.
edges.evidence: Multiple RCTs and open-label study

edges.mechanism: Bacopa accumulates Cd and Pb; ~20% of Ayurvedic products contained Pb, Hg or As; severe and fatal lead poisoning cases from Ayurvedic supplements. Use third-party-tested products, especially for children.
edges.evidence: Product surveys and case reports

edges.mechanism: Bacopa inhibits CYP1A2 in vitro; CYP1A2 metabolizes ~95% of caffeine, so caffeine exposure could rise. A Bacopa-ginseng-coffee-fruit formula was tolerated.
edges.evidence: Theoretical (in vitro + PK review)

edges.mechanism: Choline donor plus Bacopa AChE suppression: theoretical additive cholinergic effects (GI upset); choline-Bacopa combinations neuroprotective only in preclinical models.
edges.evidence: Preclinical combination studies; no human interaction data

edges.mechanism: Choline donor plus Bacopa AChE suppression: theoretical additive cholinergic effects; choline-Bacopa combinations studied only preclinically.
edges.evidence: Preclinical combination studies; no human interaction data

edges.mechanism: Frequently co-formulated; both may raise T4 (Bacopa in mice, ashwagandha in human RCT); both implicated in adaptogen-antidepressant adverse event reports.
edges.evidence: Animal + human thyroid data; pharmacovigilance; no combination safety trial

edges.mechanism: Both studied for attention/ADHD; no interaction study found; additive calming effect is theoretical.
edges.evidence: No direct evidence

edges.mechanism: Both are adaptogens in cognitive stacks; Rhodiola and Bacopa each appear in herb-psychotropic adverse interaction reports; no direct Bacopa-Rhodiola data.
edges.evidence: No direct evidence; pharmacovigilance of each herb separately

edges.mechanism: Physiological (not assay) change: possible T4 rise based on mouse data.
edges.evidence: Animal data only
